basic_information.title: Intelligent Property Marketplace and Automated Valuation System
basic_information.summary: A modern real estate marketplace that allows users to list and search properties while providing instant, AI-driven property price estimates based on location and features.

academic_information.faculty: Faculty of Built Environment and IT

abstract: The real estate market suffers from information asymmetry, where buyers and sellers often rely on biased or outdated information to determine property values. This project addresses this by developing an Intelligent Property Marketplace combined with an Automated Valuation Model (AVM). The platform functions as a robust listing service where users can browse properties via an interactive map interface. Concurrently, the integrated AVM utilizes a Random Forest regression model trained on historical sales data, geospatial features, and macroeconomic indicators to generate instant price estimates for any residential property. This empowers users with data-driven insights, facilitating fairer negotiations and more efficient market transactions.
problem_statement: Buyers and sellers struggle to determine the fair market value of residential properties due to the lack of transparent, instant, and data-driven valuation tools, relying heavily on expensive manual appraisals.

primary: Develop a user-friendly real estate listing marketplace.
Implement an Automated Valuation Model (AVM) to estimate property prices.
Integrate geospatial mapping to visualize property locations and neighborhood data.
secondary: Provide a comparison tool for similar properties in the area.
Ensure the platform is responsive and mobile-friendly.

included: Interactive map search using Mapbox or Google Maps.
excluded: Handling legal real estate transactions or escrows.
scope.deployment_context: Web application deployed on a standard cloud provider (e.g., AWS or Vercel).

features.name: Interactive Map Search
features.description: Users can browse properties on a map, filtering by price, size, and amenities.

features.name: Instant Valuation Estimator
features.description: Input property details to receive an AI-generated price estimate and confidence interval.

features.name: Property Listing Management
features.description: Allows users to upload photos, descriptions, and details to list their property.

features.name: Neighborhood Insights
features.description: Displays data on local schools, crime rates, and transit options.

modules.name: Marketplace Module
modules.purpose: Handles the core CRUD operations for property listings and user profiles.
responsibilities: Manage user authentication and saved properties.

modules.name: Valuation Engine
modules.purpose: Executes the machine learning model to estimate property values.
responsibilities: Preprocess input features (e.g., square footage, bedrooms, zip code).
Return price estimate and comparable properties.

programming_languages.name: Python
programming_languages.purpose: Data processing and ML model API.

frameworks.name: FastAPI
frameworks.purpose: Serves the ML model and core marketplace endpoints.

frameworks.purpose: Training the Random Forest regression model.

database.name: MongoDB
database.purpose: Flexible document storage for varied property features and images.

apis.name: Mapbox API
apis.purpose: Provides interactive map rendering and geocoding.

ai_usage.description: Utilizes machine learning to predict property prices based on historical data.
ai_usage.training_data: Publicly available historical real estate transaction datasets (e.g., King County Housing Data).

algorithms.name: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
algorithms.purpose: Find and recommend comparable properties (comps) based on features and distance.

reasons: Requires integration of complex mapping libraries (Mapbox).
Handling and cleaning messy real estate data for ML training.
Building a responsive and media-heavy frontend.

phase_breakdown.phase: Data collection, cleaning, and model training
Frontend UI, map integration, and testing

research_area.application_domain: Real estate transactions and property valuation

expected_outcomes: A functional real estate marketplace with map-based search.
An integrated AVM that provides immediate price estimates for user inputs.
A model evaluation report detailing the accuracy of the pricing predictions.
limitations: Model accuracy decreases in rural areas with fewer historical sales (lack of comps).
Cannot account for unrecorded property improvements or interior conditions.
Relies on historical data, which may not capture sudden market shifts.
future_scope: Implement computer vision to assess interior condition from uploaded photos and adjust valuations.
Integrate live MLS data feeds for real-time market updates.
Add augmented reality (AR) virtual tours for premium listings.
